summary: Build a single-page interactive "Be My Valentine" web page with animated gradient background, glassmorphism card UI, playful Yes/No buttons (No dodges), confetti + alert on Yes, floating hearts, and sound effects; personalized question text (e.g., "hina, will you be my Valentine?").
architectural_notes: Static single-page app using vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no framework).
Uses external CDNs/assets: Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Poppins), canvas-confetti (cdn.jsdelivr.net), and audio files from assets.mixkit.co.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page Valentine proposal UI that matches the provided HTML/CSS/JS experience: an animated multi-color gradient background; a centered glassmorphism card with a glowing gradient ring; a cat+heart emoji header; the question text "Aditi, will you be my Valentine?"; and a small italic hint line.

Implement the interactive "Yes" and "No" buttons behavior from the provided script: the "No" button should dodge by moving to a random position within the card bounds on hover (and an equivalent interaction for touch devices), while the "Yes" button triggers a confetti burst and then shows a confirmation message.
Add the sound effects specified in the provided HTML: play the hover sound when the "No" button dodges, and play the success sound when "Yes" is clicked, using the exact audio URLs provided.
Implement the floating heart particles effect across the page background, continuously spawning hearts that float upward, scale slightly, and fade out, similar to the provided timing and styling.

Update the proposal question text on the Valentine proposal card to match the provided HTML: show the recipient name as "Hina" followed by a comma, then a line break, then the text "will you be my Valentine?".
Set the browser tab title to exactly "Be My Valentine 💘" to match the provided HTML title.
